text:
Situation: Hydralazine hydrochloride 10 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 280 tablets (24.6 days on hand at 11.4 tablets per day). Corvale General holds 391 tablets (29.7 days on hand at 13.2 tablets per day). The current NDC 48433004620 label names Teva Czech Industries s.r.o. Opava-Komarov as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include hydralazine hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory provides less than 30 days of supply at both sites. No FDA shortage designation exists to trigger allocation programs. Multiple alternative manufacturers have product available and are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Ascend Laboratories, LLC for both sites; requires pharmacy director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Azurity Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as secondary source; requires pharmacy director approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Cadila Pharmaceuticals Limited as tertiary source; requires pharmacy director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor daily usage and update days-on-hand projections weekly; requires pharmacy manager approval.
5. Buyer to report supply status to P&T committee at next scheduled meeting; requires committee chair acknowledgment.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
